propositions: acli (Atlassian CLI) is a required external binary for Jira Cloud reconciliation operations but is not declared in any Python extra or documented in install-time user guidance.

Installation of jira-related extras succeeds without acli present, then every Cloud-mutating operation fails at runtime with bare FileNotFoundError([Errno 2]) that does not indicate the required remedy.
The Jira Data Center adapter does not depend on acli; it uses the jira Python library and REST client only.
A typed, actionable error (subclassing FileNotFoundError) must replace the bare errno-2 at the acli subprocess spawn site, naming the binary, Cloud path, and documentation pointer.
The missing binary must be documented in extras metadata, README, and jira-sync-setup.md with a clear install pointer and distinction between Cloud (requires acli) and Data Center (does not) paths.
